task: Write a team update with these seven constraints: (1) 715 to 715 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

Furthermore, we've addressed the feedback regarding the interface's accessibility, implementing changes to improve usability for all users. Collaboration across teams will be essential during this phase. Marketing will be closely monitoring campaign performance, adjusting messaging and targeting as needed. We anticipate a busy but productive period ahead. We greatly appreciate everyone’s dedication and hard work. Let's continue to strive for excellence in all that we do. Please remember to prioritize tasks effectively and manage expectations accordingly. The success of this project hinges on our collective efforts and unwavering commitment. 

Kind regards.
